description: This Java source file defines the InternalExternalEventService class, which provides services for managing external events within the Fineract platform. It includes methods for deleting all external events, retrieving filtered external events, and converting event data from byte buffers to readable formats. The class interacts with a JPA repository and handles payload deserialization, supporting different event types including bulk business events.

classes.name: InternalExternalEventService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing external events, including retrieval and conversion of event data, within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: deleteAllExternalEvents
methods.description: Deletes all external events from the repository.

methods.name: getAllExternalEvents
methods.description: Retrieves external events based on provided filters, converts them into a readable format, and returns a list of ExternalEventResponse objects.

methods.name: hasIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Creates a Specification for filtering external events by idempotency key.

methods.name: hasType
methods.description: Creates a Specification for filtering external events by type.

methods.name: hasCategory
methods.description: Creates a Specification for filtering external events by category.

methods.name: hasAggregateRootId
methods.description: Creates a Specification for filtering external events by aggregate root ID.

methods.name: convertToReadableFormat
methods.description: Converts a list of ExternalEvent entities into a list of ExternalEventResponse objects, deserializing payloads and handling bulk events.

methods.name: retrieveBulkMessage
methods.description: Extracts and deserializes bulk message items into ExternalEventResponse objects.

methods.name: toJsonMap
methods.description: Converts a JSON string into a Map for easy access.
